name: Dark Matter
description: The six-person crew of a derelict spaceship awakens from stasis in the farthest reaches of space. Their memories wiped clean, they have no recollection of who they are or how they got on board. The only clue to their identities is a cargo bay full of weaponry and a destination: a remote mining colony that is about to become a war zone. With no idea whose side they are on, they face a deadly decision. Will these amnesiacs turn their backs on history, or will their pasts catch up with them?

videos.title: Episode One
videos.overview: A spaceship crew awaken from stasis with no memory of their mission or their identities, but once they reach their destination, a mining colony, they begin to look for answers while working together to survive.

videos.title: Episode Two
videos.overview: The crew come to terms with revelations about their respective pasts and face the dilemma of helping the miners against insurmountable odds or abandoning them to certain death.

videos.title: Episode Three
videos.overview: Sabotage is suspected and the onboard paranoia surges when the ship mysteriously veers off course. To bring the systems back online, a perilous spacewalk is required. At the same time, Five makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Episode Four
videos.overview: The past comes back to haunt members of the crew during a stopover at a space station, during which Four makes a stunning discovery, while Two and Five learn that some games of chance come with surprising risks. Elsewhere, Six receives some unwanted attention at a local clinic; and One and Three's attempts to sell the weapons in their cargo hold lands them at a dangerous disadvantage.

videos.title: Episode Five
videos.overview: The crew are hired by their handler to salvage a seemingly deserted space freighter, a reclaim op that appears to be straightforward until a deadly cargo is uncovered and they are forced to fight for their lives.

videos.title: Episode Six
videos.overview: Chemical hypnosis and the ship's neural link are used to explore the memories secreted away in Five's subconscious, during which she uncovers the dark truth about Four and Six's violent pasts. She also learns about the circumstances that landed her on the ship and gains some insight into the idyllic childhood of a mysterious little boy.

videos.title: Episode Seven
videos.overview: The crew finally gain access to the secret room in the ship's underbelly and among the items they find inside are a sunny android and a desperately ill woman who reveals a connection to Three.

videos.title: Episode Eight
videos.overview: The crew stop at a space station to refuel and rest, but Six has a different agenda, which has to do with revenge. Meanwhile, One is taken aback by an unwelcome revelation.

videos.title: Episode Nine
videos.overview: Four abandons the ship to embark on a reckless mission to reclaim his past and the crew are left wondering whether they should rescue him or let fate run its deadly course.

videos.title: Episode Ten
videos.overview: The crew takes on a job stealing a device from a rival corporation, but another team of mercenaries have the same goal.

videos.title: Episode Eleven
videos.overview: The crew plots to reclaim the ship from the mercenaries that are determined to deliver them to the Galactic Authority.

videos.title: Episode Twelve
videos.overview: The team's handler sends the crew on another mission to retrieve a scientist being held against his will.

videos.title: Episode Thirteen
videos.overview: Crew members are targeted, and paranoia mounts as they search for the perpetrator; the person responsible for the mind-wipe makes a move.

videos.title: Welcome to Your New Home
videos.overview: The crew awakens to find themselves prisoners on the Hyperion-8 Maximum Security Galactic Detention Facility.

videos.title: Kill Them All
videos.overview: Imprisoned in Hyperion-8, the crew must negotiate attempted assassinations, extraditions, and behind-the-scenes machinations as they plot their escape.

videos.title: I've Seen the Other Side of You
videos.overview: The neural link triggers a dangerous glitch and the crew start to turn against each other while hiding out in empty space in an effort to lose the GA.

videos.title: We Were Family
videos.overview: Three manages to reconnect with his former crew. The Android ends up in some unique company.

videos.title: We Voted Not to Space You
videos.overview: The Android goes undercover to try and help the crew track a dangerous, yet familiar, foe.

videos.title: We Should Have Seen This Coming
videos.overview: Desperate for money, the Raza crew follow Nyx's lead on an op, only to discover that their target is a personal one.

videos.title: She's One of Them Now
videos.overview: Three crew members infiltrate a highly secure facility with the help of their handler.

videos.title: Stuff to Steal, People to Kill
videos.overview: A Blink Drive test goes awry, propelling the Raza to a parallel reality.

videos.title: Going Out Fighting
videos.overview: The crew takes a dangerous mission inside Dwarf Star Technologies in a desperate bid to save their ailing leader.

videos.title: Take the Shot
videos.overview: Mayhem on the ship sheds light on some crew members' dark pasts.

videos.title: Wish I'd Spaced You When I Had the Chance
videos.overview: While Five is kidnapped and Three comes to her rescue, the rest of the Raza crew must face the Galactic Authority.

videos.title: Sometimes in Life You Don't Get to Choose
videos.overview: Four's loyalty is put to the test when he attempts to reclaim the throne of Ishida.

videos.title: But First, We Save the Galaxy
videos.overview: The crew of the Raza works to prevent the destruction of a space station and prevent an all out corporate war.

videos.title: Being Better Is So Much Harder
videos.overview: The scattered survivors of EOS-7 battle to regroup amidst the backdrop of corporate war. Ryo Ishida, now emperor of Zairon, makes an enemy of his former allies, while the past comes back to haunt the crew of the Raza.

videos.title: It Doesn't Have to Be Like This
videos.overview: The crew of the Raza target an Ishida research station in an attempt to take back the Blink Drive.

videos.title: Welcome to the Revolution
videos.overview: After receiving a distress call from a former associate, the crew of the Raza find themselves in the middle of a colony's fight for independence.

videos.title: All the Time in the World
videos.overview: Unbeknownst to the rest of the crew, Three has been trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day.

videos.title: Give It Up, Princess
videos.overview: The crew must rescue kidnapped royalty to retrieve a file which could halt intergalactic war.

videos.title: One Last Card to Play
videos.overview: It's Raza vs Raza when other dimensional alternates of the crew steal weapons, the real crew must get them back.

videos.title: Wish I Could Believe You
videos.overview: A familiar face returns as one of the Raza crew learns a game changing bombshell about their past.

videos.title: Hot Chocolate
videos.overview: While providing safe transport for some allies, the Raza comes under attack from within.

videos.title: Isn’t That a Paradox?
videos.overview: When the Blink Drive self activates during a diagnostic, the Raza and its crew are transported through space and time.

videos.title: Built, Not Born
videos.overview: A distress call from the Android's friend Victor leads to answers about Two's past.

videos.title: The Dwarf Star Conspiracy
videos.overview: One of the Android's newly discovered memories leads the crew to a suspicious Dwarf Star facility on Nova 17.

videos.title: My Final Gift to You
videos.overview: Ryo takes a hostage to trade for the Blink Drive, but his former crew are not his only opponents.

videos.title: Nowhere to Go
videos.overview: The Raza's crew attempt to unite Ferrous' enemies and put an end to the corporate war before the new fleet can be used.
